name: DeleteDraftEmail
description: Deletes an existing draft email from a specified Microsoft 365 mailbox using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select Microsoft 365 credentials used to authenticate the request.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox containing the draft email.

fields.name: DraftId
fields.label: Draft ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the draft email to delete.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the draft email deletion operation.
